tools.name: search_pressbox_news
tools.description:
Search public Pressbox press releases by topic, category or issuer name.

Read-only first-party news retrieval. Result pages can be independently
inspected and cited. Search does NOT imply any other assistant has cited it.

tools.name: get_pressbox_release
tools.description:
Fetch one already-published release by its Pressbox public release ID.

Returns verified public source text, a canonical URL and factual issuer
metadata. It cannot retrieve drafts, private contacts or journalist lists.

tools.name: latest_pressbox_news
tools.description: List the latest public Pressbox releases; optionally select a category.

tools.name: get_pressbox_newsroom
tools.description: Find an issuer's public Pressbox newsroom and recent published releases.

tools.name: get_pressbox_public_capabilities
tools.description:
Explain exactly what Pressbox exposes to AI and what requires consent.

These capabilities apply only to this public, read-only connector. Creating
or distributing releases requires an entirely separate OAuth-protected
application and the user's explicit approval.
